name: Composite Refactoring Sequence #3: Extract Methods from Complex Logic
description: Real-world example from Commons-Lang: 22 Extract Method refactorings

smells.description: indexOf() method is 200+ lines with nested loops
Cyclomatic complexity of 25+ in string searching logic
replace() method with 180 lines of character manipulation
Similar boundary checking logic in indexOf, lastIndexOf, contains
substring() helper is 100+ lines with edge case handling
Nested if-else with 8+ conditions for null/empty checks

refactoring_sequence: Extract common logic from replace() - 5 separate extractions
Extract substring edge case handlers - 8 separate extractions
Extract null/empty checking logic - 4 separate extractions
